member.name: M:RaceDay.Api.Controllers.AuthController.Register(RaceDay.Api.Models.RegisterDto)
member.summary: Registers a new Organiser or Participant account.
member.remarks: Send fullName, email, password, role and optional phoneNumber. Organisers must also send the organiserCode. Returns 201 on success, 400 for bad input, 403 for a wrong organiser code, 409 if the email is already used.

member.name: M:RaceDay.Api.Controllers.AuthController.Login(RaceDay.Api.Models.LoginDto)
member.summary: Logs a user in and returns a JWT token containing their role.
member.remarks: Send email and password. Returns 200 with a token to use in the Authorize button, or 401 if the credentials are wrong.

member.name: M:RaceDay.Api.Controllers.CategoriesController.Create(System.Int32,RaceDay.Api.Models.CategoryDto)
member.summary: Adds a category (e.g. 10km, 21km, Under 20) to an event (Organiser who owns the event only).
member.remarks: Send categoryName, maxParticipants and entryFee. Returns 201, 400, 403 (not an Organiser, or not your event) or 404 (event not found).

member.name: M:RaceDay.Api.Controllers.CategoriesController.GetForEvent(System.Int32)
member.summary: Lists all categories of an event (any logged-in user).
member.remarks: No body needed. Returns 200 with the categories, or 404 if the event does not exist.

member.name: M:RaceDay.Api.Controllers.EnrolmentsController.Enrol(System.Int32)
member.summary: Enrols the logged-in Participant into a category (Participant only).
member.remarks: No body needed, the participant comes from the token. Returns 201, 403 (not a Participant), 404 (category not found) or 409 (already enrolled, or category full).

member.name: M:RaceDay.Api.Controllers.EnrolmentsController.GetMine
member.summary: Returns all enrolments of the logged-in Participant (Participant only).
member.remarks: No body needed. Returns 200 with the participant's own enrolments, or 403 for Organisers.

member.name: M:RaceDay.Api.Controllers.EnrolmentsController.GetForEvent(System.Int32)
member.summary: Returns all enrolments for one event (Organiser who owns the event only).
member.remarks: No body needed. Returns 200, 403 (not an Organiser, or not your event) or 404 (event not found).

member.name: M:RaceDay.Api.Controllers.EventsController.Create(RaceDay.Api.Models.EventDto)
member.remarks: Send eventName, description, eventDate, location, distance and eventType (Run, Walk or Cycle). Returns 201 with the event, 400 for bad input, 403 if the caller is not an Organiser.

member.name: M:RaceDay.Api.Controllers.EventsController.GetAll
member.summary: Lists all upcoming events (any logged-in user).
member.remarks: No body needed. Returns 200 with the events ordered by date.

member.name: M:RaceDay.Api.Controllers.EventsController.GetById(System.Int32)
member.summary: Returns the details of one event, including its categories (any logged-in user).
member.remarks: Returns 200 with the event or 404 if it does not exist.

member.name: M:RaceDay.Api.Controllers.EventsController.Update(System.Int32,RaceDay.Api.Models.EventDto)
member.summary: Updates an event (Organiser who owns it only).
member.remarks: Send the same fields as when creating. Returns 200, 400, 403 (not an Organiser, or not your event) or 404.

member.name: M:RaceDay.Api.Controllers.EventsController.Delete(System.Int32)
member.summary: Deletes an event and its categories and enrolments (Organiser who owns it only).
member.remarks: No body needed. Returns 200, 403 (not an Organiser, or not your event) or 404.

member.name: M:RaceDay.Api.Controllers.ResultsController.Capture(System.Int32,RaceDay.Api.Models.ResultDto)
member.summary: Records a participant's finish time and position (Organiser who owns the event only).
member.remarks: Send finishTime and position. Returns 201, 400, 403 (not an Organiser, or not your event), 404 (enrolment not found) or 409 (result already recorded).

member.name: M:RaceDay.Api.Controllers.ResultsController.GetForEnrolment(System.Int32)
member.summary: Returns the result for an enrolment (the participant who owns it, or the Organiser of that event).
member.remarks: No body needed. Returns 200, 403 (not your result) or 404 (enrolment or result not found).
